```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(arrow) # This plugin is primarily used to quickly load large CSV files.
source(here("R", "od_io.R"))
```

```{r}
build_od_parquet()
od <- open_od() # lazy: nothing is read into memory yet
od
```

```{r load-od-2020}
# Filter first, then collect() only the rows you need. MODE is "train" or
# "bus"; YYYYMM is an integer such as 202001. Bus stop codes stay as text, so
# leading zeros (e.g. "01012") are kept for joining with spatial data.
dfB20 <- c(202003, 202006, 202009, 202012)

od_bus_2020 <- od |>
  filter(MODE == "bus", YYYYMM %in% dfB20) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
head(od_bus_2020)
```
